items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: Some of them I played with and... Some I never had to play the playing with. I knew them personally.

ctx.x: No, that's not. Yeah, I believe it is bouncing around. Mm-hmm. Did the younger T.O. ever play any of the Scott Joplin numbers?

Yeah, he played all that music. You see, back in those days, back in the... 1919, 1908, where the district was operating. A lot of cabarets. Most of those musicians played there. That's all they was playing back in those days, you know. That type of music. Big Ilui and Tiku and... All those men. Well, they're much older men than I am. Yet I knew them. Some of them I played with and... Some I never had to play the playing with. I knew them personally.
But you said you worked in the district yourself. You must have been working out.
